# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Overview

Jekyll static blog deployed via GitHub Pages from the `gh-pages` branch (which is also the default branch — there is no `main`). Custom domain `codersite.dev` (see `CNAME`). Content focuses on programming, algorithms, system design, and book reviews/affiliates.

## Commands

```bash
bundle install                # install gems (first run)
bundle exec jekyll serve      # local dev server with live reload
bundle exec jekyll build      # one-off build into _site/
JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build   # enables Google Analytics block (see _layouts/default.html)
```

There is no test suite, linter, or JS build step. The site is plain Jekyll + Bootstrap 4 (CDN) + jQuery.

## Architecture

### Two parallel sites in one repo

1. **The Jekyll blog** (root) — driven by `_config.yml`, `_layouts/`, `_includes/`, `_posts/`, `_pages/`. Posts use the `post` layout, which extends `default.html`.
2. **Standalone book landing pages** under `book/` and `recommended/` — hand-written HTML (e.g. `book/codeInterview.html`, `book/landing_cracking.html`, `book/softwareDesignPrinciples.html`) with their own CSS/images. These are **not** Jekyll-rendered templates; they're shipped as static files. Treat them independently of the Jekyll layout pipeline.

### Posts

- Live in `_posts/` as `YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md` (or `.markdown`). Permalink is `/:title/` (no date in URL — see `_config.yml`).
- Front matter pattern in use: `layout: post`, `title`, `description`, `author` (must be a key under `site.authors` in `_config.yml` — currently `moises` or `aiAvatar`), `categories: [ ... ]`, `image: assets/images/...`, `comments`.
- Categories drive the archive at `/category/:name/` via `jekyll-archives`.
- Pagination: 6 posts/page at `/page:num/`.

### Includes are mostly ad/affiliate units

`_includes/` contains the usual Jekyll partials (`disqus`, `mailchimp`, `share`, `toc`, `pagination`, `search-lunr`, `google-tag`) plus a large set of book-affiliate ad blocks (`effectiveJava.html`, `introducingGradle.html`, `softwareDesignAd1.html`, `crackCodingInterviewCallToAction1.html`, etc.). When a post references one of these via `{% include ... %}`, it is an ad placement, not structural content.

### Layout chain

`default.html` is the shell (nav, footer, AdSense, GA, Mailchimp bar, categories jumbotron). All other layouts (`post`, `page`, `archive`, `categories`, `tags`, `page-books`, `page-recommended`) extend it. AdSense `<script>` is conditionally included only when `page.layout` is `post`, `default`, `tags`, or `categories` — keep that gate intact when adding new layouts that should monetize.

### Production-only behavior

`{% if jekyll.environment == 'production' %}` gates Google Analytics in `_layouts/default.html`. Local `jekyll serve` will not load GA — that's expected, not a bug.

### SEO assets

`sitemap.xml` and `feed.xml` live at the repo root and are regenerated by `jekyll-sitemap` / `jekyll-feed` plugins; don't hand-edit them. `ads.txt` and `site.webmanifest` are static.

## Conventions when adding a post

- File: `_posts/YYYY-MM-DD-kebab-case-slug.md`.
- Use an existing category from the corpus where possible (the categories jumbotron in `default.html` lists the live set at build time).
- Image lives at `assets/images/<name>.<ext>` and is referenced via `image:` in front matter for OpenGraph/Twitter cards (`jekyll-seo-tag` reads it).
- Author key must exist in `_config.yml`'s `authors:` map.

## Deployment

GitHub Pages builds from the `gh-pages` branch automatically — pushing to `gh-pages` deploys. No CI config in the repo.
